items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, he's a distant cousin of mine. That's my first cousin's son.

ctx.x: Now, I got some little nephews. My brother got some kid there. He got a, he got a boy there. Nice clarinet player, but he don't want to play no more. He used to, he, he started out with St. Augustine Band. Down there when he's gone to school down at St. Augustine. And, but he don't want to bother with it, but he's got his oldest son, he's in, uh, Palazzo, California, he plays. He's got his daddy's own. He plays piccolo and, uh, and sax. The last time he's down there, he told me he's got a little band out there…
Well, is Eddie Boccage any kind to you? Eddie Bo? Who? Eddie Boccage. Yeah. Eddie Bo? Yeah.

Yeah, he's a distant cousin of mine. That's my first cousin's son. Eddie Bo. Which first cousin is that? That's, uh, Freddie Boccage. And he, is that a brother of Pete and? Well, he, none of them played no music. He had another brother by the name of, uh, They had Freddie, they had, uh, and there's another one, uh, uh, Oh, I can't call it. Both of them dead though. Freddie's too. Freddie's the oldest one living. How old is Freddie now? How old is Freddie? Freddie, right. I guess Freddie ought to be close around…
